name: video-stitch
description: Type-safe, secure video editing for Node.js powered by FFmpeg

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --include 'dist/esm/**/*.js' --exclude 'dist/esm/index.js' --exclude 'dist/esm/types.js' --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --check-coverage --lines 90 --functions 90 --statements 90 --branches 85 node --test test/unit/*.test.mjs test/integration/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:package
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run pack:check && npm run audit
scripts.verify:release: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:coverage:built && npm run pack:check:built && npm run audit
